name: blog-page
title: Blog page
description: The blog: the head, the categories with a search beside them, the posts three across as blog cards, every card in a row one height, and the closing band. Nothing matching says so.
never: Pagination: the posts load in one list
A featured post larger than the rest
body: Built on `site-page`: `header`, `footer` and `announcement` are its props, and the `logo` and `actions` slots go to the header (`sheet-actions` too, in web components). The category and the search filter the `posts` in place; a post is blog-card's props.
